name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
description: App sidebar with grouped links, a sliding active indicator, collapsible sub-items, an icon rail mode, and an off-canvas dialog on narrow layouts.

props.name: sections
props.type: { title?, items: { label, href?, icon?, badge?, active?, disabled?, open?, children? }[] }[]
props.description: Link groups. icon is an SVG path (d) for a 24px stroke icon. Items with children become toggle buttons.

props.name: header
props.description: Brand or workspace at the top. In rail mode only the first 32px stay visible. Angular: <ng-template #header>, since it renders in the sidebar and the mobile dialog.

props.name: footer
props.description: User profile at the bottom. Angular: <ng-template #footer>.

props.name: children
props.description: Page content shown next to the sidebar.

props.name: variant
props.description: default sits flush with a right border, floating is an inset rounded panel.

props.name: breakpoint
props.description: Container width from which the sidebar shows next to the content: 24rem, 42rem, or 56rem. Below it a button opens it as a dialog.

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Icon rail mode. React: controlled with onCollapsedChange. Vue: v-model:collapsed, or a plain value for the uncontrolled initial state. Svelte: bind:collapsed or a plain initial value. Angular: [(collapsed)] or a plain initial value. Blade and Astro: initial state, changes dispatch markas-collapsed-change.

props.name: defaultCollapsed
props.description: Initial rail mode when uncontrolled (React only).

props.name: collapsedChange
props.description: Angular only. Emits the new rail state when it changes.

props.name: navLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the nav and the mobile dialog.

props.name: collapseLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the rail toggle while expanded.

props.name: expandLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the rail toggle while collapsed.

props.name: openLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the button that opens the mobile dialog.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the close button in the mobile dialog.

a11y: Links sit in a nav labelled by navLabel, the current page gets aria-current=page, and each titled group is a list labelled by its title.
Items with sub-items are disclosure buttons with aria-expanded and aria-controls, closed sub-items are hidden from focus.
The rail toggle uses aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing to the sidebar. In rail mode labels stay readable by screen readers and show as tooltips on hover and focus.
On narrow layouts the sidebar opens in a native modal dialog: Escape or the backdrop closes it and focus returns to the open button.
Disabled items are links without href and with aria-disabled=true.

ai.whenToUse: Main navigation of an app or dashboard with many destinations, grouped by area.
rules: Mark exactly one page with active, sub-item groups that contain it open on their own
Give every top-level item an icon so the rail mode stays usable
Put the page content inside the component so the off-canvas mode and container query work

id.description: Sidebar aplikasi dengan grup link, indikator aktif yang meluncur, sub-item yang bisa dibuka, mode rail ikon, dan dialog off-canvas di tata letak sempit.

props.sections: Grup link. icon berisi path SVG (d) untuk ikon garis 24px. Item dengan children menjadi tombol buka/tutup.
props.header: Brand atau workspace di atas. Di mode rail hanya 32px pertama yang terlihat. Angular: <ng-template #header>, karena dirender di sidebar dan dialog seluler.
props.children: Isi halaman yang tampil di samping sidebar.
props.variant: default menempel dengan border kanan, floating berupa panel membulat yang mengambang.
props.breakpoint: Lebar kontainer mulai sidebar tampil di samping konten: 24rem, 42rem, atau 56rem. Di bawahnya tombol membuka sidebar sebagai dialog.
props.collapsed: Mode rail ikon. React: terkontrol bersama onCollapsedChange. Vue: v-model:collapsed, atau nilai biasa untuk keadaan awal tidak terkontrol. Svelte: bind:collapsed atau nilai awal biasa. Angular: [(collapsed)] atau nilai awal biasa. Blade dan Astro: keadaan awal, perubahan mengirim event markas-collapsed-change.
props.defaultCollapsed: Mode rail awal saat tidak terkontrol (hanya React).
props.collapsedChange: Khusus Angular. Dipancarkan dengan keadaan rail baru saat berubah.
props.navLabel: Label aksesibel nav dan dialog seluler. Isi "Sidebar" atau "Navigasi samping" untuk situs berbahasa Indonesia.
props.collapseLabel: Label aksesibel tombol rail saat sidebar terbentang. Isi "Ciutkan sidebar".
props.expandLabel: Label aksesibel tombol rail saat sidebar diciutkan. Isi "Bentangkan sidebar".
props.openLabel: Label aksesibel tombol yang membuka dialog seluler. Isi "Buka sidebar".
props.closeLabel: Label aksesibel tombol tutup di dialog seluler. Isi "Tutup sidebar".

a11y: Link berada di nav berlabel navLabel, halaman saat ini diberi aria-current=page, dan setiap grup berjudul adalah list berlabel judulnya.
Item dengan sub-item adalah tombol disclosure dengan aria-expanded dan aria-controls, sub-item yang tertutup tidak bisa difokus.
Tombol rail memakai aria-expanded dan aria-controls yang menunjuk ke sidebar. Di mode rail label tetap terbaca pembaca layar dan tampil sebagai tooltip saat hover dan fokus.
Di tata letak sempit sidebar terbuka di dialog modal native: Escape atau backdrop menutupnya dan fokus kembali ke tombol pembuka.
Item nonaktif adalah link tanpa href dengan aria-disabled=true.

ai.whenToUse: Navigasi utama aplikasi atau dashboard dengan banyak tujuan yang dikelompokkan per area.
rules: Tandai tepat satu halaman dengan active, grup sub-item yang memuatnya terbuka sendiri
Beri ikon pada setiap item tingkat atas agar mode rail tetap bisa dipakai
Taruh isi halaman di dalam komponen agar mode off-canvas dan container query berjalan
